architectural_fidelity.reason: The Cova render has fundamentally altered the room architecture: the large sliding glass door on the right has been replaced with a solid wall with vertical paneling and sliding door, the window placement appears different, and the camera angle/viewpoint has shifted significantly, making this feel like a different room rather than the same space redesigned.

furniture_removal.reason: All original furniture has been completely removed with no ghost outlines, remnants of the green sofa, coffee table, chairs, or any phantom shadows visible.

style_commitment.reason: Clear Scandinavian execution with light wood tones, neutral palette, minimalist gallery wall with mixed frame styles, clean-lined furniture, and natural materials—this is unmistakably committed to the style, not generic neutral.

editorial_density.reason: Severely under-styled for editorial standards: only one small loveseat, one side table, minimal accessories, no layered textiles beyond what appears on the sofa, no rug, no multiple light sources, no coffee table, no styled vignettes—this reads as empty staging rather than Architectural Digest-level lived-in completeness.

photorealism.reason: Generally photorealistic lighting and shadows, but the floor texture has an unnaturally uniform, slightly plasticky quality and the sculpture/figure on the right feels oddly placed and rendered, reducing overall believability.

designer_preference_reason: Collov demonstrates complete, publication-ready staging with proper furniture scale, layered textiles, and editorial density that clients expect, despite being a different room type.
what_cova_does_better: Maintains original gallery wall concept with similar aesthetic
Natural light quality and window shadows are realistic
what_collov_does_better: Delivers fully realized editorial-level staging density
Provides multiple lighting sources and layered textiles
specific_fixes_if_failing: Preserve the original sliding glass door on the right wall—this is a critical architectural feature
Add a substantial area rug to anchor the seating area
Include a coffee table and additional seating (at least one chair)
Layer in throw pillows, blankets, and textiles on seating
Add floor lamp and table lamps for multiple light sources
Style the credenza with books, objects, and decorative items
Add more plants beyond the two currently shown
Maintain original camera angle and viewpoint for true before/after comparison
